system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The instruction that defines an agent's personality, expertise, and behavior. It is the most important part of an agent's configuration. Also called the system prompt or agent profile.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent configurable system role; no code inspected.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Your question is embedded, compared to stored file chunks by meaning, and the most relevant chunks are given to the agent so it answers from your data.
env_context_strategy.note: Knowledge base embedding RAG plus tool-driven file/web navigation.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The ability of vision-enabled models to see and understand uploaded images, including describing them, comparing them, answering questions about them, and extracting text (OCR).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Plugins provide a means to extend the [Function Calling][docs-function-call] capabilities of LobeHub.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: LobeHub acts as the MCP client; MCP servers run locally (STDIO) or remotely (Streamable HTTP) and expose tools, resources, and prompts.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: An open standard for connecting agents to external tools, data, and services. LobeHub acts as the MCP client

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: supports modes such as sequential, parallel, iterative, and debate

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: A built-in skill that brings the Getting Things Done method into chat, letting an agent capture, track, complete, and reschedule tasks from natural language.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The coordinator in a group that understands your goal, assigns work to the right member agents, orders their contributions, and summarizes the result.
multi_agent_topology.note: Single agent chat is also common; groups are an explicit product feature.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Scoped helper agents that a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) spawns to handle parallel or isolated work.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Statuses move from backlog to in progress to review to done.
human_in_loop.note: Memory entries also require user approval.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A unit of agent work with a status, instructions, an assignee, and an activity log.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A collection of uploaded files, stored as searchable vector chunks, that an agent can reference
long_term_memory.note: Also Memory: personal context recalled later; Skills are installable capabilities.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: A single conversation thread with an agent or group. Topics can be searched, renamed, favorited, archived, shared, and grouped by time.
state_persistence.note: Persisted conversations in a database can be continued.

self_verification.evidence_quote: A function an agent calls to take an action, such as searching the web, generating an image, or managing files.
self_verification.note: No harness-enforced verification documented in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The pool of credits available to spend, checked before each AI request... a request is blocked when the budget is too low.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Different models consume different amounts per request, and credits are drawn from your free allowance, subscription, referral rewards, and top-ups.
cost_controls.note: Budget = token_budget; per-agent/mid-conversation model switching noted; TTS cached playback.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: A secure, isolated cloud environment where an agent can run code, create files, and execute commands, returning real output instead of just code snippets.
execution_isolation.note: Desktop app can also run local CLIs (Claude Code/Codex) as subprocesses.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The folder a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) treats as the project root for a session.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Lets an agent retrieve up-to-date information from the internet and cite its sources.
network_policy.note: No network restriction documented in the evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: A per-conversation setting that switches an agent between Agent mode (can use tools, a runtime environment, and memory to work autonomously)
permission_model.note: No per-call approval documented; Risk Control targets account abuse, not tool calls.

tracing.evidence_quote: A record of credits consumed by a request, itemized by model, token usage, and source (chat, image, bot, API, or scheduled run).
tracing.note: Tasks also keep an activity log; repo contains an agent-tracing skill.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: An installable capability that gives an agent new tools, such as web search, code execution, or a third-party connector.
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner visible in the provided evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Safeguards that detect and block abuse such as bulk fake registrations and referral fraud.
guardrails.note: Also Budget blocks requests before execution.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Connect your agents to the skills you use every day with a library of over 10,000 tools and MCP-compatible plugins.
target_domain.note: swe via Claude Code/Codex integration; web via web search.

open_source.evidence_quote: This project is [LobeHub Community License](./LICENSE) licensed.
open_source.note: Community license, not plain OSI; commercial features inactive when self-hosted.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: LobeHub integrates many providers, configured under Settings.
